name: National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cagayan de Oro Leg
short_description: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cagayan de Oro Leg is a half-marathon event held on August 23, 2026, at Centrio Mall in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines.
ai_summary: The National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cagayan de Oro Leg is scheduled for August 23, 2026, at Centrio Mall, Corrales Avenue, in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines. Organized by RUNRIO Inc., the event is part of the long-running MILO Marathon series and offers multiple distances including 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and the primary 21.1km half-marathon. Registration for this leg is currently open.

research_highlights: The 2023 Cagayan de Oro leg drew over 9,300 runners across 21K, 10K, 5K and 3K categories, and was notable as the first marathon to run along the city's newly opened boulevard.

In 2024, Cagayan de Oro hosted the National Finals for the first time ever in Mindanao, with over 12,600 participants and, for the first time, a 42K category in the city, with the course running from Velez Street to Tagoloan town in Misamis Oriental.
The race is organized by RUNRIO Inc. with local partners, and has historically included pre-race community events such as a City Hall-hosted carbo-loading dinner for qualifiers.
The event has previously been livestreamed on MILO social media platforms, drawing large national viewership when Cagayan de Oro hosted the Finals.

faqs.question: When is the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cagayan de Oro Leg taking place?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled for August 23, 2026. It will be held at Centrio Mall along Corrales Avenue in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines, and is organized by RUNRIO Inc. as part of the broader MILO Marathon series held across the country.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from in this race?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from five distance categories: 1km, 3km, 5km, 10km, and the primary 21.1km half-marathon. This range allows both casual participants and more experienced runners to select a distance that matches their fitness level and racing goals.

faqs.question: Who is organizing this race and where will it be held?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by RUNRIO Inc., the group behind the MILO Marathon series. It will take place in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines, with the venue set at Centrio Mall on Corrales Avenue, a central and accessible location in the city.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open for this event?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the National MILO Marathon 2026 – Cagayan de Oro Leg is currently open. Interested participants can sign up ahead of the August 23, 2026 race date to secure their spot in one of the available distance categories.
